newsitem.title: USA: Enron to take $300 mln equity in Italy deal.
newsitem.headline: Enron to take $300 mln equity in Italy deal.

text.p: Enron Corp said that it would take a $300 million equity stake in its proposed electricity generating joint venture with Italy's Ente Nazionale per l'Energia Elettrica SpA (ENEL) and its Italian partner will take a similar amount.
A spokeswoman for the company said that the venture, for which a letter of intent had been signed in Houston on Tuesday, would also said some $2.4 billion in debt.
"These figures are preliminary and many details of the venture need to be worked out," she said. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
